summary: Iter446 Storage Bulk Import wizard frontend testing — end-to-end sweep of the 5-step CSV import flow at /storage-auctions/bulk-import as verified admin (Bidvex Inc., QC). All happy-path and error scenarios rendered correctly. Wizard rendering, template download (fixed columns, no buyer_premium / no accepted_legal_notice), CSV validation (bilingual per-cell error pills), duplicate detection (both in-batch and cross-facility open drafts), legal-notice gate, draft creation, Photo Studio and publish CTA all work. Bilingual toggle showed one gap (see below).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the FR button in the navbar while on /storage-auctions/bulk-import redirects away from the page (page shows footer only, three 'Enchère introuvable' toasts fire from auction lookup calls). User loses their upload/preview state. The rest of the site works in FR (navbar/footer translate), but the wizard itself gets navigated off. Setting localStorage.bidvex_language='fr' alone before load also does NOT switch the wizard to FR — the app's i18n detector uses a different storage key, so the header/steps/pills stay in EN. Only the FR route redirect switches i18n.language.

verified_scenarios.step1_template_columns: column preview text has NO 'buyer_premium' and NO 'accepted_legal_notice'
verified_scenarios.csv_download: Downloaded CSV header contains all 19 required columns; NO buyer_premium; NO accepted_legal_notice
verified_scenarios.step2_reject_missing_columns: toast: 'Missing required columns: description_en, end_time, start_time, starting_price, unit_type. Download the template.'
verified_scenarios.step2_reject_over_50_rows: toast: 'Maximum 50 rows per import. Your file has 51.'
verified_scenarios.step3_per_cell_errors: Observed pills: unit_size_invalid, bill96_description_fr_required, past_due_required_for_lien, deposit_amount_required, end_before_start, description_en_too_short
verified_scenarios.step3_duplicate_in_batch: duplicate_unit_in_batch pill surfaces on the 2nd occurrence within a single upload
verified_scenarios.step3_duplicate_in_facility: Re-uploading the same valid CSV after creating drafts surfaces 2 'duplicate_unit_in_facility' pills on the unit_number cells (with #short-id link)
verified_scenarios.step3_legal_gate: Confirm button is disabled until storage-legal-notice-checkbox is checked; becomes enabled after check
verified_scenarios.step3_confirm_success: Creates 2 drafts, advances to Photo Studio
verified_scenarios.step5_photo_studio: Drafts render as storage-draft-card-<id>, each with red 'Needs 1 photo' pill; unmatched-list section present

action_items: Minor: Make the FR/EN navbar toggle preserve the current /storage-auctions/bulk-import route instead of redirecting to /fr/marketplace (or wherever). Also, consider syncing the wizard's isFr with the bidvex_language localStorage key so the QA note in the brief ('Set localStorage bidvex_language=fr') works without a toggle click.
critical_code_review_comments: StorageBulkImportPage.js line 271: useEffect has empty dep array; if the auth token loads asynchronously the initial /pending call may fire before token is available. Not blocking (silent catch) but the returning-user pending queue may not repopulate on first paint for slower auth hydration.

StorageBulkImportPage.js: on confirm-error path (line 197) the code overwrites row errors with just the server-returned ones — any client-side per-cell errors already visible are wiped. Small UX regression risk but acceptable since server is source of truth.
StorageBulkReviewTable.jsx: t = useTranslation().t is imported but unused; can remove.
The 'FR' language toggle behaviour on this deep route needs to preserve context (see integration issue).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard fully functional. Bilingual pill/legal text is rendered via isFr flag driven by i18next; UI FR translation for the wizard itself was not visible during this test because the navbar FR toggle navigates the user off the bulk-import route. If you want to verify FR text in-place, either (a) log in with a user whose preferred_language is fr so i18n boots to fr, or (b) run `await page.evaluate("() => window.i18next && window.i18next.changeLanguage('fr')")` after the wizard loads.
